high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The room features a wooden sofa set with a matching coffee table, all in a warm, rich brown tone. The sofa is adorned with three yellow cushions, adding a pop of color to the neutral palette of the room. Two armchairs, also in the same brown wood finish, flank the sofa on either side, each with a single yellow cushion. The floor is covered by a large area rug with a geometric pattern in shades of gray and white, which complements the light wooden flooring.
